title: Approval of the Acceptance of funding from the Transportation Security Administration: Consisting of $1,515,000 under the National Explosives Detection Canine Team Program and $1,916,250 under the Law
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 10]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Acceptance of funding from the Transportation Security Administration: Consisting of $1,515,000 under the National Explosives Detection Canine Team Program and $1,916,250 under the Law Enforcement Officer Reimbursement Program for Los Angeles International Airport (Antoinette Chandler)
summary: LAX will accept $1,515,000 from the federal Transportation Security Administration for its explosives-detection canine team, plus $1,916,250 to reimburse law enforcement officer costs.

locations.text: Los Angeles International Airport, Los Angeles, CA
